steps.content: The Misery Puppet transforms into a cloud of white smoke and vanishes. You are all once again exiled back to the amusement park's gate.
You're still gripping Hecate's hand, but she's no longer here.
No matter how many times you call her name, she won't answer.
The shackles can't locate her, and those unfocused eyes can't see you anymore.
She's not here anymore, only the old man's voice is echoing in your ears.

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: The park is not for humans, you'll only get lost if you stay for too long...

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: Lost on the way to see her, and you'll never get to see her...
He leans onto the stone steps, repeating the Carnival's endless curse.
